interpretation: Retain all positive-area INDEC-source to CEUR-target overlaps. Do not choose a preferred provider, winner, nearest feature, or canonical geometry.
known_limitations: Three source-invalid INDEC polygons remain visible as invalid source relation rows and are not repaired.
Thirteen source-invalid CEUR target polygons are excluded from the analytical target set and counted explicitly in QA.

An unmatched or low-coverage INDEC source may therefore reflect either a true cross-source coverage difference or exclusion of a source-invalid CEUR target; A5 does not repair or adjudicate that distinction.
Positive area and overlap shares are geometric facts in EPSG:6933, not population or ownership allocations.
A5 does not select a canonical geography or create a one-to-one crosswalk.
